LESSON: INTRODUCTION TO INTEGRATED SCIENCE

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
Strand: Scientific Investigation
Topic 1.1: Introduction to Integrated Science

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Introduction to Integrated Science
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How is the knowledge acquired in Integrated Science useful in daily life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain the importance of science in daily life
2. show interest in learning Integrated Science at junior school

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Introduction to Integrated Science

Teach
• Observe Introduction to Integrated Science in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Introduction to Integrated Science (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Introduction to Integrated Science.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Introduction to Integrated Science.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Introduction to Integrated Science.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• explain the importance of science in daily life
• show interest in learning Integrated Science at junior school

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Introduction to Integrated Science.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Introduction to Integrated Science: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How is the knowledge acquired in Integrated Science useful in daily life?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• explain the importance of science in daily life
• show interest in learning Integrated Science at junior school

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
